annotations.title: Answer a question a sheet asks

description: Writes the person's answer to one of their sheet's questions (from list_todo), as if they tapped it in To do. Only answer what the person told you. value is the choice's text, a list of choices for multi_choose, true or false for confirm, or the text, number or date (YYYY-MM-DD). Approvals and repeat checks can't be answered here.
name: answer_question
title: Answer a question a sheet asks
